column1: # sorter_owner_requirements.tsv -- what a good sign-sorter page must do for the owner, in his words, one row per requirement.
# Started 9 Oct 2026 02:2x UTC by the account-3 orchestrator after the owner's mobile session (Harley 287 f.88r, Armstrong 1808)
# and his ask: "if you have the code for what a great sorter is we can just reuse. Instead of manually describing each time."
# Every row must become an automatic check (iPhone 13 + iPhone SE emulation) in the shared sorter recipe; a page that fails any
# row is not sent to the owner. Add a row (with date and the owner's words) every time he reports a sorter problem.

column2: The line strip is visible on an iPhone in the larger view (not a sliver)
column3: I can't see the strip at all. Mentioned this twice yesterday or day before. / "See, strip is borked"
column5: Harley 287 comments 01:57, 02:00 (also reported twice on 7-8 Oct)
column6: canvas CSS height >= 80 px on iPhone 13 and SE; strip pixels non-blank

column2: The larger view shows the lines above and below the sign
column3: I can't see above or below the symbol. There may be things worth seeing.
column6: context image includes >= 1 line height above and below the tile box (whole-page region or padded strips)

column2: A cut can be fixed in every direction, including onto the line above or below
column6: Fix the cut: drag/nudge each of top, bottom, left, right beyond the line band and Save; saved box differs as expected

column2: Question tiles ("Check these first" / "Most useful first") start already taken out, so one tap places each
column3: If they were already taken out I could put them in piles. Otherwise now I have to click on them to view them. Click to take out of this pile, then apply them to correct pile.
column6: page lands on step 2 with question tile 1 large; one tap on a pile card places it and advances; nothing saved until he acts

column2: ONE gesture rule on every page and in every box (piles, 'Check these first', 'Most useful first', tray): a single TAP takes the sign out into the 'to be decided' tray; a HOLD opens the sign's page large (on its line, with the answer buttons)
column3: If I hold on this I can move the piece. If I click on it once I'm taken into it / "Tap take out of pile, hold open symbol page" / "This is what I want. One tap it takes the symbol out and puts it in my tbd pile. If I hold on the symbol open [the] symbol page."
column5: Harley 287 comment 01:59; Armstrong 1808 comment 02:18; Armstrong 1808 comment 02:37 (the rule itself)
column6: iPhone 13 + SE emulation: tap a tile in each box -> it is in the tray and nothing else opened; hold a tile in each box -> the large view opens on its line; the page's hint text says exactly this; no box overrides it

column2: Pages already sent to the owner get every later fix (no stale versions)
column3: Why we make same mistakes over and over?
column6: registry of live sorter URLs; at each check-in every live page's template marker equals the current one or it is re-rendered and republished

column2: No colour-only cue that depends on red vs green (owner is red-green colour-blind)
column6: cvd_check (Machado deutan/protan) on every state pair; every state also has a shape/glyph/border cue
re-render keeps sids; a fixture with saved moves reloads with the same piles and no re-trayed decided tiles

column2: The sign card walks the family it was opened in: from a pile tile (member, set-aside or waiting question) or "View larger", Left/Right keys, Previous/Next and a sideways swipe step through every sign shown under that family heading in on-screen order, stop at either end without wrapping and say so in words; after a move, set aside, bad cut, trash, keep, new sign or saved cut the card shows the next sign of the same family
column3: When I hit left or right keys while into one of the family, it moves to another symbol, but doesn't seem to be continuining in that family. I think it should ,then when you hit the end of that family unit it stops. So I the human can easily click through and knock out a whole family with new cuts or moves.
column5: Matignon f.110 sorter, account-3 chat 11 Oct 03:1x UTC
column6: tools/sign_sorter/browser_tests/test_family_nav.js (desktop keys + buttons, iPhone 13 swipes + taps; family.html and family_plain.html from make_fixtures.py): the card list equals the family tiles in DOM order across two piles with set-aside and waiting tiles; walks end-to-end; no wrap; end text "Last of N in family F"/"First sign in family F"; position "n of N in family F, pile P"; every decision shows the next sign of the fixed list; tray and "Check these first" cards keep their lists
